prompt_authorship: The five subject descriptions and shared prompt template were generated with AI assistance and manually reviewed and approved by the student.
prompt_template: Studio image of {subject_description}. Isolated, centered, fully visible, three-quarter view, plain gray background, diffuse lighting, realistic material. No people, props, text, logo, watermark, cropping, or duplicates.
prompt_template_rationale: The shared template keeps composition, viewpoint, background, and lighting consistent across cases while isolating a single complete object with strong boundaries for the downstream single-image TRELLIS.2 reconstruction. Subject descriptions vary the intended geometric or material challenge without changing the imaging conditions.
subject_description: a stylized compact lunar rover toy with four ribbed wheels, a small tilted dish antenna, and an asymmetric instrument box
expanded_prompt: Studio image of a stylized compact lunar rover toy with four ribbed wheels, a small tilted dish antenna, and an asymmetric instrument box. Isolated, centered, fully visible, three-quarter view, plain gray background, diffuse lighting, realistic material. No people, props, text, logo, watermark, cropping, or duplicates.
challenge: multiple components, count consistency, and asymmetry
selection_rationale: Create a multi-part count-sensitive case in which any FLUX omission or merger can be traced directly into the final 3D result.
analysis_focus: A candidate limitation case if FLUX changes wheel count, merges components, or hides the antenna attachment.
